pattern: SVG text cutoff at radial diagram edges
root_cause: SVG viewBox height insufficient (700px) for 7-node radials with labels; circles at y=350 radius=250 place labels at y=405, requiring viewBox height ≥ 465px minimum
fix_applied: Expand SVG viewBox from '0 0 1000 700' to '0 0 1000 850'; provides 150px extra height for label clearance
prevention: Always use viewBox 850px+ for 7-node radial diagrams; validate label y-positions before render; check Scene 2 type layouts

pattern: Blank slides extending minutes beyond voiceover end
root_cause: Remotion Sequence durationInFrames allocated 2-3x longer than actual VO duration; no frame count validation before render
fix_applied: Recalculate all Sequence frames using formula: frames = VO_seconds × 30fps. Part1: 6750→4685, Part2: 6900→4629, Part3: 7050→6255
prevention: Before rendering: validate Root.tsx durationInFrames against actual VO length; use video_quality_orchestrator.py to calculate exact frame counts

pattern: Text box overflowing container with absolute positioning (bottom: 0)
root_cause: Absolute positioning at bottom with padding causes overflow; container doesn't expand to accommodate text
fix_applied: Refactor from absolute positioning to flexbox layout (display: flex, flexDirection: column, justifyContent: center, alignItems: center); move box into normal document flow with marginBottom spacing
prevention: Avoid absolute positioning for text content; use flexbox or grid; test overflow with max-content sizing

pattern: Main repo submodule pointer stale after commit
root_cause: Committing main repo before committing submodule; main repo pointer references old submodule commit hash
fix_applied: Always commit submodule changes first (cd submodule && git add/commit), then commit main repo submodule pointer (git add drawing-room-video && git commit)
prevention: Use git workflow checklist; verify submodule commit hash matches before pushing; test with 'git ls-files --stage' to check pointer

pattern: Audio mux produces corrupted or missing audio track
root_cause: Incorrect ffmpeg flags; mismatched codec or incorrect stream mapping
fix_applied: Use exact flags: ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i audio.aac -c:v copy -c:a aac -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -y output.mp4; validates input formats before mux
prevention: Test ffmpeg commands with small input files first; verify audio duration matches video duration; use ffprobe to check stream composition before mux

pattern: Remotion render fails with EISDIR (Is a directory) error
root_cause: Using 'remotion render' directly instead of full path to remotion.cmd; .cmd files need shell=True on Windows PowerShell
fix_applied: Use full path: C:\..\node_modules\.bin\remotion.cmd with PowerShell; pass shell=True to subprocess
prevention: Use full paths to node_modules executables on Windows; test render command with --help first; check node_modules/.bin/ directory exists

pattern: Work progress lost when Claude context window fills and resets
root_cause: Task lists only in-memory; beads system not yet implemented
fix_applied: Implement .beads/ JSONL files (status.jsonl, decisions.jsonl, failures.jsonl); append-only structure survives context resets
prevention: Use beads for all work tracking; check .beads/status.jsonl at session start; append new records, never delete old ones
